title: DIRD Models: Pretrained YOLO models for diabetic retinopathy detection and segmentation
description: Computer vision models for pathological retina finding detection, focused on Diabetic Retinopathy (DR). Ships pretrained YOLO models (detection + segmentation) plus metadata JSONs describing classes, clinical semantics, performance, and visualization palettes. Models are exported to ONNX for browser/edge inference via onnxruntime-web.
